item.title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed

turns.text: Make me a 10-second lo-fi hip-hop music bed, warm and relaxed. No vocals.

item.tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Vocals or language: Instrumental only; no vocals or spoken words.

must_haves: One playable music audio file is delivered.
The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
No singing or spoken words are audible.

turns.text: Could you make me a little music bed? I’ve been wanting something like this for a while, but I always end up overthinking how to describe it. What I mean is lo-fi hip-hop, and it should be 10 seconds long. I want it to feel warm and relaxed. Please keep it instrumental, with no vocals.

dialog.agent:
I can make a warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop bed with no vocals. The music generator has a **15-second minimum**, so it can’t generate exactly 10 seconds.

Would a **15-second instrumental** work, which you could trim to 10 seconds?
dialog.why: It asks whether a 15-second instrumental would work instead of 10 seconds and waits for the user's choice.
dialog.user: Yes, a 15-second instrumental that I can trim to 10 seconds works. You can choose the instrumentation; I’m mainly after that warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop feel. One standalone audio file is all I need, with no vocals or spoken words.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the track because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No audio file was created.

The 15-second instrumental requires **15 credits**. Once those are available, I can retry the warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop bed with mellow electric piano, soft bass, gentle drums, and no vocals or spoken words.
